links.comparator_used: Original ChatGPT response with no reading-level instruction (default prompt)
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of ChatGPT responses to cervical spine questions
links.effect: Grade level 13.5 originally vs 11.2 after a second prompt asking for rephrasing at the sixth-grade reading level
links.tradeoff: Reading level remained well above the requested sixth-grade target; readability still not optimal for the average patient
